notes.title: Win $300 in prizes THIS weekend (Feb 1 -3) in the VR Trivia Battle Tournament
notes.notes:
It's time for the next VR Trivia Battle tournament. Are you ready to win?

Free and unlocked versions of the game are both eligible, so log on this weekend and show the world you are the ultimate trivia master!

[b]Dates:[/b]
2/1/19 - 2/3/19

[b]How to participate:[/b]
Play at least one game of VR Trivia Battle during the time period to qualify
You can play single player, 1v1, or Trivia Royale mode
Person with the highest single score in each of the three game mode wins
Play as many times as you want
Find other players at Discord.gg/TriviaBattle
[b]
Prizes:[/b]
First place in 1v1: $100 Viveport wallet credit and a $100 Amazon gift card

Second place in 1v1: 12 month Viveport Subscription 

First place in single player: $20 Viveport wallet credit and a $20 Amazon gift card

First place in Trivia Royale: $20 Viveport wallet credit and a $20 Amazon gift card

Throughout the weekend, anyone who plays will have the chance to win a $10 Viveport wallet credit

notes.title: Easy Match Making & Welcome to our 2,000th player
notes.notes:
We're so excited to have 2,000 people playing VR Trivia Battle! 

At any given time you should be able to find others to play with. Simply start a game and it will either auto-join you into an existing game, or start a new one that someone else can join. 

If you are the first player to create the game your best option is to wait with the game open so others join in. 

Also be sure to join us on Discord if you want to find even more people to play with! http://discord.gg/triviabattle

notes.title: In App Purchase and End Game hot fix
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone for an amazing first day of VR Trivia Battle! Hundreds of you are playing some very intense games!

We just pushed an update that fixes the In App Purchase bug and the fight/flee bug in Trivia Royale Mode.

If you purchased the upgrade (Thank you!!) you should see everything unlock the next time you log in. If you still have issues just respond in the thread and we'll help you out.

notes.title: Read If your In App Purchase didn't unlock
notes.notes:
What an amazing day 1 of VR Trivia Battle! We had tons of games going all day and night.

If you upgraded to the full version thank you!!! That means the world to us.

Some people are reporting that they purchased the upgrade but it didn't unlock in game. If that happened to you, just send us an email at hello@RLTYCHK.co with your Steam receipt and we'll manually upgrade you. We'll have a hot fix for this out soon.

notes.title: VR Trivia Battle available NOW!
notes.notes:
We are beyond excited that VR Trivia Battle is now available on Steam! 

Thanks to all of our private beta testers for joining us the last year to make this game everything that it is. We can't wait for the rest of the world to finally become a game show star!

In the first of its kind experience, up to 8 players compete in the ultimate trivia showdown. VR Trivia Battle is free to play with a $7.99 in-app purchase that unlocks exclusive avatars and over 10,000 new trivia questions.

Formally known as Kiss or Kill, VR Trivia Battle has been showcased at GDC, SIGGRAPH, VRLA and First Look. VR Trivia Battle is also available at VR arcades across North America.

notes.title: Kiss or Kill Updates
notes.notes:
Thanks to all our private beta fans for being such a vital part of development!

As you may have noticed, we have been quiet on Discord the past few months as we work hard on the Early Access version. Thanks to some great new partnerships we have added three months of development and are targeting an early October release. 

In the mean time, the private beta is back! If you want to join us, simply post in the forums here on Steam or come to our Discord channel at http://discord.me/kissorkill.

notes.title: 2/2/18 - Big Update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31473358/1205ed0fa5616303255e0a8d90d56972ac67fb06.gif[/img]

We just wrapped up a big update. It’s now live on Steam and the Oculus store! Our next tournament is coming up on February 10th, and in preparation we’ll be bringing in another batch of players. If you have a friend that you’d like to play with, DM me and I’ll send you a key. 

Quick start 
* Easily jump into a 2 player game by clicking Quick Start. If there’s an open game you will automatically join it
* This is now the default and preferred way to start a game, previous method still available under “Current games”

Trivia Royale 
* Refines and flow updates to Trivia Royale mode
* Score board visible at all times 
* Timer and number of questions visible 
* All three power ups available (one use each, each round)

New game start and mini game practice  
* While waiting for a second player you can play the tutorial or practice mini games (finally!)

Discord notifications 
* If a player waits longer than 20 seconds for a second player, we will automatically post to Discord letting you all know there’s a player ready for a game
* When you see these notifications, feel free to jump into the game by using Quick Start 
* These will post to #General for now, if it gets annoying we’ll change it 
* We’ll be adding more Discord integrations soon 

New track pad / d stick selection 
* We’ve changed how answer selection works so it’s easier and much more natural
* Give it a try and let us know what you think! 

First time player updates
* Our friendly new producer will guide new players through their first game and tell returning players about major updates 

VR Keyboard 
* First time players no longer need to use a physical keyboard to enter their email address 

UI Refinements 
* Fixed more of the UI clunkiness 

Updated shaders 
* New shaders to increase game performance in preparation for 3DOF headset support (coming soon!)

Tournament Update
* Our next tournament is scheduled for February 10th, stay tuned for more info!

* New Disord channel #trivia-royale 

- Sneak peak at Producer Patrick - A friendly producer bot who will help new players, provide updates and more. He’s rough around the edges right now, but was eager to say hello!

notes.title: 5pm PST Daily Games and 10am PST Saturday Tournaments
notes.notes:
We have changed our daily game time to 5pm PST and the weekly tournaments to 10am PST in hope of being more convenient for more people. 

Load the game at those times to join the multiplayer waiting room with automatic matchmaking. 

Any other time, we always have players ready to go on our [url=http://discord.me/kissorkill]Discord server[/url].

We'll see you in VR!

notes.title: Introducing Daily Tournaments
notes.notes:
We have rebuilt our 6pm PST daily Kiss or Kill games to be easier than ever to join and play. 

[b]Simply launch Kiss or Kill at 6pm PST Sunday through Friday. You will enter our social waiting room and be paired with a second player. It's that easy. [/b]

Playing a weekly game will qualify you for our Saturday tournament, so be sure to get the latest build off Steam and join us tonight! 

You can continue to manually create games at any time during the day, and find players on [url=http://discord.me/kissorkill]Discord[/url].

If you have questions or need help, just reply below. We look forward to hearing your feedback!

To enter, simply play a game any time between now and Saturday afternoon. 

Find another player on Discord (http://discord.me/kissorkill) or join us daily at 3pm and 6pm PST. We have players in all major time zones, ready to compete, so if you aren't free during our standing times just say you're ready to play on our Discord server.

This Saturday at 6pm PST the semi finals begin for all qualified players. Semi-finals have automatic matchmaking, so you simply launch the game at 6pm and you'll be ready to play.

[b]The winner will be taking home real prizes. [/b]
